Flat, calm. No wind. Bright sun. Warm. EXCELLENT viewing conditions. Surface covered with pollen, debris, dead insects, etc. (probably from Blackwood Creek); probably cut down on light transmission and Secchi readings.

Ripple with SW wind @3 kn. Sky ~80% low cumulus. Cooling off. Sky reflection from clouds. Only FAIR viewing conditions. Water is definitely green in color, probably due to the influence of Blackwood Creek runoff. POC composite took a long time to filter. Some pollen on surface. PPr filters also "colored". Note surface temperature difference between here (9.5 C) and yesterday's MLTP0063 (12.2 C) after the SW wind yesterday P.M.

Smooth swells from E. Light breeze. Intermittent rain showers. Cloud cover 100%, but GOOD viewing conditions. The water is distinctly blue-green again and, even with low light conditions, the Secchi depth is again VERY shallow!
Waves ~0.5 ft. Windy from SW @10-15 kn. FAIR viewing conditions.

Ripples ~0.5 ft. Wind SW at 5 kn; gusts. Sky clear and sun warm but surface conditions are FAIR-to-GOOD. Secchi disk was given a fresh coat of flat white paint prior to this LTP. It may have increased readings by a meter or so?? Check against last LTP Secchi depth and comparable light readings.

Small waves and ripples. Sky overcast and sun intermittently behind clouds. Wind SW @~2-3 kn. FAIR viewing conditions. Wind over last 3 days has caused significant lake water temperature drop and upwelling.
Waves ~1-1.5 ft. SW wind @10 kn. Small whitecaps. Sky free of clouds, but hazy. Only FAIR viewing conditions.
Smooth ripples. Light breeze. No clouds. Smog moderate. Warm. EXCELLENT viewing conditions.

Small waves are now choppier. Light NE breeze. Small cumulus clouds passing by. FAIR-to-GOOD viewing conditions. It appears that an Asterionella bloom has begun as the Tucker trawl samples are turning green upon formalin addition.
Waves 0.5 to 1.5 ft. Wind west @2-4 kn and gusty. Clouds passing over sun occasionally. Cool and cloudy around the basin. Wind, waves, and some sky reflection make for FAIR viewing conditions.

Overcast. Low cumulus cover ~90%. Cold and snow flurries. Waves and ripples ~0.5 ft. Much sky reflection. FAIR viewing conditions.

Flat, calm. Warm and sunny but heavy in-basin smog and some high, thin stratus. EXCELLENT viewing conditions. A phytoplankton bloom is in progress! Zooplankton net was quite plugged on all 3 tows (Asterionella?).
Ripples with SW breeze ~1-2 kn. No clouds. GOOD viewing conditions. Phytoplankton bloom is still going strong; net plugging again.
Smooth ripples and light breeze. Sunny, but hazy. GOOD viewing conditions. Nets heavy again with phytoplankton.
Calm, smooth ripples. Sun bright, but low angle. Cumulus cloud cover ~20%, moving in from the west. GOOD viewing conditions.
Now rippled with breeze from the east @~1 kn. Still, GOOD viewing conditions.

Flat, calm. High, moderate overcast moving in from the west; sun shining through. No wind. Warm. EXCELLENT viewing conditions. There appears to be a heavier bloom of net plankton now than earlier this year; the 80-micron net is plugging badly!

Smooth ripples. Sky overcast but sun shining through. GOOD viewing conditions. There were very strong SW winds yesterday which appear to have re-mixed cold water back up to the surface. However, Secchi is still shallow and phytoplankton bloom continues.
Smooth ripples from SE light breeze. Bright, sunny. Scattered clouds ~15%. GOOD viewing conditions. Phytoplankton bloom has not abated in the least!
Flat, calm. High, thin haze over sun. Warm and sunny. EXCELLENT viewing conditions. Bloomin' Asterionella are still here!
Surface rippled. Sky now overcast in front of sun. SW wind @5-10 kn with 15-kn gusts. FAIR viewing conditions.
Rippled. Sun bright. Wind SW @5 kn. GOOD viewing conditions. Water seems slightly clearer. Water temperature seems to indicate some upwelling has occurred.
FAIR-to-GOOD viewing conditions. Surface rippled and sky reflection noticeable. Cloud cover 50% but none over sun now.

Flat, calm. No wind or clouds. EXCELLENT viewing conditions. Some pollen on lake surface. Water seems to be clearing, but Asterionella are growing deeper now. A random 30-->0 m zooplankton tow was almost all Diaptomus and Epischura and few net phytoplankton.
Smooth ripples. Light breeze. Sun out from behind 60% cloud cover. GOOD viewing conditions. Asterionella bloom continues to decrease a bit.
Flat, calm. Bright sun. Warm. Moderate "smaze" in basin. No wind. EXCELLENT viewing conditions. Some pollen on lake surface. Lots of pollen in water.

Smooth ripple with light SE breeze. Hazy sun. Cool. GOOD viewing conditions. Amount of "macro-algae" in zooplankton tows has decreased somewhat.

Smooth ripples. Bright, warm sun. No wind. A few wispy clouds about--nice! Boat not moving. EXCELLENT viewing conditions. Water has cleared considerably due to cold, stormy conditions during last few days (upwelling). Many zooplankton or detrital particles evident near surface.

Calm. Smooth ripples. No clouds over sun. Warm. No wind. But smoky. EXCELLENT viewing conditions. Over past 1.5 week, smoke filled Tahoe basin--several fires all over California. Smoke now very heavy from Rubicon R. fire. Visibility improved from ~3 mi. to 10-15 mi. today.

FAIR TO GOOD conditions due to ripples, 100% sky reflection, and weak sun.
Whitecaps, with small waves and gusty winds SW @15-20 kn. Sky now overcast. FAIR viewing conditions.

Reading checked twice. 35.5 m both times. Flat. Calm. No clouds over sun now! No wind. Cold. EXCELLENT viewing conditions. Phytoplankton bloom beginning? Fluorescence readings "jumpy" due to large alga (Uroglena) in samples.
Waves ~1 ft. SW wind @5 kn. Sky slightly overcast. FAIR-to-GOOD viewing conditions.
Glassy, calm. No wind or waves, nor clouds. EXCELLENT viewing conditions.
Flat, calm, etc. EXCELLENT viewing conditions.

Has the spring bloom begun? Fluorometer readings still fluctuating due to colonial alga, Uroglena americana -- a Chrysophyte. Light ripple with SE breeze. Sky clear and sun bright. GOOD-to-EXCELLENT viewing conditions.

Flat, calm. Bright, warm sun. No clouds. EXCELLENT viewing conditions. Colonial algal bloom (Uroglena americana) continues because I can see what looks like "bubbles" in the reflected-back light from the Secchi disk as I lower it.

Smooth ripples. Bright sun. Calm, no wind. Warm. EXCELLENT viewing conditions. Uroglena bloom continues with perhaps more colonies than last time. Bkg. fluorescence increases 10-15 units by passage of colony through light beam.
Flat, calm. Very hazy sky. No wind. Sun warm. Moderately heavy basin smog. EXCELLENT viewing conditions! Fluorescence varies widely due to large colonies of Uroglena-type cells.

Waves ~1/2 ft. Wind SW @2-3 kn. Sun behind clouds. Snowing lightly. Only FAIR viewing conditions! Uroglenopsis sp. now very prevalent in surface water and easily seen with backlight reflectance--a major bloom (~20 colonies/ml)! Fluorescence readings very unstable and variable.

Ripple and cool SE breeze @1-2 kn. Sky ~75% covered with high, moderate stratus which is changing continually. GOOD TO FAIR reading conditions. Uroglena is still very abundant, but perhaps a little less. Fluorescence readings easier to make due to fewer colonies.

A lot of small insect and/or zooplankton carcasses on the surface. Ripples ~6". Wind picking up SW @2-5 kn in gusts. Sky clear, sun bright. GOOD viewing conditions. Wind and waves came up for DAF's reading.

Flat, calm. Cool but sunny. No clouds over sun. Smoggy in basin. ~5% thin, scattered stratus. EXCELLENT viewing conditions.
Flat, calm. Cool. Bright sun. No wind. Smoggy in basin. EXCELLENT viewing conditions!

Smooth. No visible sun. Snowing lightly. No wind. 100% low cloud cover. GOOD-to-EXCELLENT viewing conditions even with 100% cloud cover and sky reflection. Other readings by RCR --> (I=36.5 II=35.0 off Obexer's @12:53).
Flat, calm. No wind. Bright sun. EXCELLENT viewing conditions.
Surface rippled. Wind SW and gusty @2-15 kn. Sky hazy but sun fairly bright. FAIR-to-GOOD viewing conditions.
Smooth swells. Bright sun. Very thin clouds. EXCELLENT viewing conditions.
Smooth, calm. Perfect. Can't get much better.
Flat, calm. Warm, bright sun.
Smooth ripples. Cool. Bright sun. ~30% clouds around basin. EXCELLENT viewing conditions.
Small waves. Raining. Wind NW @1-2 kn. 100% cloud cover, no sun visible. FAIR viewing conditions.
Rippled. Cool. SW wind @5 kn. Much sky reflection. FAIR-to-GOOD viewing conditions.
Smooth ripples. Bright sun. Light, SE breeze. GOOD-to-EXCELLENT viewing conditions.
Waves ~1.5 ft. Gusty, SW winds @10-25 kn. Warm. Light, in-basin smog. High, cirrostratus clouds. Cloud cover ~30%.
Waves ~0.5 ft. Sky clear. Sun bright. Cool. Wind SW @5 kn but now calming down. GOOD viewing conditions.
Calm. No clouds or wind. Warm, bright sun. EXCELLENT viewing conditions.
Smooth ripples. Warm sun. High, variable stratus. Light breezes. EXCELLENT viewing conditions.
Smooth ripples. Bright sun. No clouds. Light E breeze. GOOD viewing conditions.
Waves ~3/4 ft from E. Easterly breeze up to ~3 kn. Bright sun. A few clouds. GOOD viewing conditions.
Smooth ripples. Calm winds. Warm. Bright sun. Some small cumulus forming around basin. EXCELLENT viewing conditions.
Smooth ripples. Light breezes. Some sky reflections. GOOD viewing conditions.
Smooth. Bright, warm sun. No clouds or wind. EXCELLENT viewing conditions.
Waves 1-1.5 ft. Whitecaps. SW wind @10 kn, gusts to 20 kn. No clouds over sun. FAIR-to-GOOD surface conditions.
Flat, calm. Bright sun. No clouds over sun, but basin is quite smoggy. EXCELLENT viewing conditions.
Smooth ripples from SE. Sun bright. No clouds in the way. Light breezes. Heavy, in-basin smog. EXCELLENT viewing conditions.

Large, smooth ripples. 90% overcast and sky reflection make viewing a bit difficult. FAIR-to-GOOD conditions. Uroglena americana colonies have reappeared (2-5 colonies per fluorometer test tube from 0 to ~40 m depth -- none in deeper samples).
Smooth ripples. SW breeze @1-2 kn. Moderate stratus over sun. Lots(!!) of Uroglena americana in water. GOOD viewing conditions.
Flat, calm, no wind. 100% cloud cover. Moderate sun. EXCELLENT viewing conditions. Uroglena americana is interfering with a better Secchi disk reading!

Smooth and calm. Bright sun. No clouds or wind. Balmy. Wonderful. EXCELLENT viewing conditions, but Uroglena americana is hampering view (also causing large fluctuations in fluorescence measurements).

Waves 1 ft. Wind SW @10 kn, gusts @15 kn. Whitecaps. Sky reflection and the moderate haze over sun make for only FAIR viewing conditions. Uroglena americana colonies present (can effectively double or triple the fluorescence temporarily!).
Flat, calm, no wind. Bright sun with low angle. Basin hazy. EXCELLENT viewing conditions except for the "pesky" chrysophyte (Uroglena americana) bloom!

Waves from east ~1-1.5 ft. Lake has calmed down quite a bit (0-2 kn). Sky clear. Sun angle quite low. GOOD viewing conditions. Uroglena americana is still predominant and is hampering Secchi readings!

Gusty SW winds @2-10 kn. Waves ~0.5 ft with whitecaps. Sky clear. Sun angle low. Fewer waves during Secchi reading due to boat acting as a damper! Equals GOOD viewing conditions. Uroglena americana seems to be decreasing a bit?
Flat, calm. Bright sun (low sun angle). Cool. No clouds. EXCELLENT viewing conditions. Uroglena americana is still around (?) but not very common in fluorometer samples.

Rippled. West wind (breezes) picking up. Sun slowly decreasing as high status moves in from the west. GOOD viewing conditions. It looks like Uroglena americana has finally crashed! The water is getting more transparent, too.
Smooth. E breeze @1 kn. Sun covered with moderate clouds. GOOD-to-EXCELLENT viewing conditions. It looks as if a Dinobryon/Asterionella bloom is beginning!

Flat, calm. Bright sun with no clouds over it. Warm. Lots of cumulus clouds around basin (~50%), some with rain showers! Large storm 8-10 days ago brought 3-4 ft of snow to the west shore at lake level!
Small, 0.5 ft waves. Easterly breeze @1-2 kn. But GOOD-to-EXCELLENT viewing conditions. The strong SW winds yesterday caused a lot of upwelling and a corresponding increase in clarity.

Flat, calm. Warm, bright sun. No clouds. EXCELLENT viewing conditions! It appears that more upwelling occurred again yesterday with the SW winds @10-20 kn bringing up cold, clear water (see temperature readings).
Smooth ripples. Breeze from the east. Light cirrus clouds over sun and they're increasing. GOOD-to-EXCELLENT viewing conditions. Zooplankton net seems to be plugging more.
Smooth ripples. Bright sun. Some jet contrails around. EXCELLENT viewing conditions.
Ripples and 2 kn wind from SE. GOOD viewing conditions. Water appears somewhat turbid and bluish-green.
Waves ~0.75 ft from NE as wind dies down. Sun bright and clear. GOOD-to-EXCELLENT viewing conditions. Water is a bit "cloudy" looking.
Viewing conditions FAIR-to-GOOD. Ripples. Sky reflections and gusty breezes.
Waves. Cold wind @5-10 kn. Boat drifting quickly. Bright sun. Water looks greenish. Only FAIR-to-GOOD viewing conditions.
Rippled waves ~0.5 ft. SW breeze gusty @3-5 kn. Sky clear. Water appears turbid, greenish-blue. FAIR-to-GOOD viewing conditions.
Ripples with light breeze from SE. Bright sun. Approx. 15% cumulus cloud cover around the basin.
Calm, smooth. No clouds.
Smooth water. Calm. Scattered clouds (~40% of sky). GOOD viewing.
Calm. Clear, no clouds. Bright sun.
Smooth ripples. Bright warm sun. Moderate-to-heavy, in-basin smog. No wind. GOOD-to-EXCELLENT viewing conditions.
Waves ~0.5 ft. SW gusty breezes. Sun out. FAIR-to-GOOD viewing conditions.
Calm. Smooth swells. EXCELLENT viewing conditions.
Smooth swells. Sun hazy with alto-cumulus small clouds passing over sun continuously. GOOD-to-EXCELLENT viewing conditions.
Small waves from the east with 1-2 kn breeze. Sun out. GOOD viewing conditions. 4-5 days of stormy weather preceded this LTP.
Flat, calm. No clouds. Sunny. EXCELLENT viewing conditions.
Smooth, easterly swells ~1-1.5 ft. Sun bright, but sun angle starting to get lower. GOOD-to-EXCELLENT viewing conditions.
Waves ~0.5 ft. Wind SW @3-5 kn. Sun angle getting lower! GOOD viewing conditions.
Calm. EXCELLENT viewing conditions.
Waves ~1 ft. Sky partly cloudy with low cumulus passing sun. Cold, 18 degrees F. FAIR viewing conditions with sun behind clouds.
Flat, calm. Bright sun. EXCELLENT viewing conditions!
Smooth ripples. Wind gusty (from 0 to 5 kn). Sky cloudy with 90% thin stratus moving over sun. Sun angle low. FAIR-to-GOOD viewing conditions.
Ripples and breeze from SW. Cool. No clouds. Sunny, but LOW sun angle. GOOD viewing conditions in lee of boat.
Waves ~0.5 ft. Sky 100% overcast and snowing. But sun sometimes seen faintly. FAIR-to-GOOD viewing conditions.
Rough. Waves 1.5-2 ft from east. Sky with moderate cirrostratus overcast--changing slightly. Sun visible but low in sky. FAIR-to-GOOD viewing conditions.

Ripples and 2 kn breeze from SE. Sky 100% clear, but moderate smog in basin. Sun angle low. GOOD viewing conditions. Lake has a dusty, greenish cast to it from a fairly large, globular, amorphous, variably-shaped alga (Botryococcus Braunii).
Smooth ripples. Fog lifting but sill 95% cover at ~400 ft. Calm. Sun shining weakly. GOOD viewing conditions. Botryococcus Braunii still prevalent.
Light ripples. Sun warm but covered with high, light-to-moderate stratus -- changing gradually. GOOD-to-EXCELLENT viewing conditions.
Flat, calm. 100% overcast cumulus. Snow flurries around basin. Light breezes. Some sky reflection from overcast. GOOD viewing conditions. Stormiest March (snowfall) in at least the last 20 years.
Waves ~1.5 ft from NE wind @ 2-4 kn. Sky clear. GOOD viewing conditions. March has been the stormiest in recent history (over 20 years) bringing more snow than in all of the previous winter months.

Smooth ripples from E. Sun warm and bright. Light in-basin smog. Light breezes. EXCELLENT viewing conditions. Upwelling has occurred as evidenced in the temperature profile and the slightly deeper Secchi reading.
Flat, calm. Bright, warm sun. Thin haze over most of the sky; 5% cumulus and 20% stratus to the south. EXCELLENT viewing conditions.
Flat, calm. No clouds. EXCELLENT viewing conditions.
Waves ~0.5 ft from the SW with 2-3 kn breeze. Raining. Sun very dim through 100% overcast. A lot of sky reflection. FAIR-to-GOOD viewing conditions.
Flat, calm. No sky reflection or wind or ripples. EXCELLENT viewing conditions.
Waves ~0.75 ft. Wind gusty from SW @3-5 kn with occasional small whitecaps. Bright sun. GOOD viewing conditions. Pollen is evident on water surface.
Ripples ~0.5 ft. Wind SW @2-5 kn. GOOD viewing conditions. Lots of pollen on lake surface and in zooplankton tows.
Bright sun. Smooth ripples from W. Breezy. ~40% cumulus cloud cover. Some sky reflection. GOOD viewing conditions.
Smooth swells. Bright, warm sun. No clouds. EXCELLENT viewing conditions. Lots of pollen on lake surface.
Ripples. Gusty SW breeze. Bright, warm sun. No clouds. Moderate in-basin smog. GOOD viewing conditions (some sun reflection).
Smooth ripples. Heavy smog. Bright, warm sun. A few small clouds beginning to appear. EXCELLENT viewing conditions.
SW breeze @5 kn. Small whitecaps and 1-foot waves. GOOD viewing conditions.
Smooth swells from boat wakes. Bright, warm sun. Moderate-to-heavy in-basin smog. ~10% cumulus clouds. GOOD-to-EXCELLENT viewing conditions (except for boat wakes).
Surface rippled from 10-15 kn winds. Bright sun. FAIR-to-GOOD viewing conditions.
Smooth 1 ft waves from NE. Sky overcast 90% with low cumulus over sun. Only FAIR-to-GOOD viewing conditions.
Flat and calm. Bright and warm sun. No clouds but moderate-to-heavy basin smog. EXCELLENT viewing conditions.
Flat, calm. Warm sun. No clouds in the way. Light breezes. EXCELLENT viewing conditions.
Large swells from SE ~1.5 ft. Light breeze @~1-3 kn. Sky overcast over sun with thin stratus. Warm but smoggy. Conditions a bit calmer at the time of Secchi measurement. GOOD viewing conditions.
Waves ~0.5 ft with gusty breeze @5-10 kn now from SW. FAIR-to-GOOD viewing conditions.
Flat, calm. EXCELLENT viewing conditions.
Flat, calm. Light surface ripples. Hazy. Warm sun. No wind. GOOD-to-EXCELLENT viewing conditions but low sun angle.
Light ripples and swells. Sky overcast with thin stratus over sun. Warm sun. Light breeze. GOOD-to-EXCELLENT viewing conditions.
Light ripples. SE breeze. Low sun angle. No clouds but hazy. Cool. GOOD-to-EXCELLENT viewing conditions.
Flat, calm. 85% high, thin cloud cover--some over sun making sun hazy. Cool. Light level changing rapidly. Low sunlight level. Otherwise GOOD viewing conditions.
Flat, calm. Moderate-to-heavy, variable, stratus clouds over sun. Warming a bit. Hazy sun. Sky reflection. GOOD-to-EXCELLENT viewing conditions.
Smooth 1.5 ft swells from the east as wind dies down. Bright sun but low on horizon. Light smog. GOOD viewing conditions.
Flat, calm again. Sun a little brighter. GOOD-to-EXCELLENT viewing conditions.
Waves ~2 ft with whitecaps. NE wind @5 kn. FAIR viewing conditions.
Ripples from NW. Breeze @3-5 kn. Snowing lightly. Sun obscured behind clouds. Sky reflection gives FAIR-to-GOOD viewing conditions.
Waves ~1.5 ft from east. Sun bright. FAIR-to-GOOD viewing conditions.
GOOD viewing conditions but the sun was obscured. Smooth ripples. Light snow. Ceiling lifting. Visibility now ~10-15 miles. 100% overcast. Sky reflection.
Smooth ripples. 100% cloud cover and sky reflection. But GOOD viewing conditions.

Flat, calm. Warm. Sun out. Slight sky reflection. No wind. EXCELLENT viewing conditions. Lake seemed clearer today and Secchi and light readings verify that! There may have been some upwelling this past week (?)
Ripples and light SE breeze. No clouds. Bright sun but smoggy. Warming. EXCELLENT viewing conditions!
Flat, calm. Warm. No wind. Hazy sun with stratus. EXCELLENT viewing conditions.

Gusty SW wind 1-10 kn. Waves ~0.5' high. Sun slightly __?__. GOOD viewing conditions except for waves and a bit of sky reflection. Chlorophyll fluorescence curve indicates upwelling event (probably yesterday afternoon during strong SW winds).
Whitecaps. Gusty SW winds. Waves ~1 ft. Boat drifting despite backing down with engine. Sun bright and clear. FAIR-to-GOOD viewing conditions.
Waves ~0.75 ft from East with a cool 2 kn breeze. Sky hazy and bright. Some sky reflection now from clouds moving in. But GOOD viewing conditions.
Flat, calm. Bright, warm sun. EXCELLENT viewing conditions. Clarity has increased a lot since last LTP.
Sun in and out of clouds. Wind E @2 kn. ~0.5 ft waves. FAIR-to-GOOD viewing conditions.
Flat, smooth. No wind. Bright, warm sun. But noticeable haze everywhere.
Due to wind and overcast, only FAIR-to-GOOD viewing conditions.
Smooth ripples. Bright, warm sun. Cumulus forming but not over sun yet. Light breeze. EXCELLENT viewing conditions.
Smooth ripples. Bright, warm sun. Smog increasing in basin from a forest fire to the north of the basin near Verdi. EXCELLENT viewing conditions.
Waves, gusty wind, and ripples making for only FAIR-to-GOOD conditions. There was a large fire near Yosemite at Moccasin this week which may affect the lake?
Smooth swells from boat wakes. Warm, bright sun but basin hazy. ~10% cumulus now around basin rim. GOOD-to-EXCELLENT viewing conditions.
Flat, calm. Bright sun. Smoggy, but EXCELLENT viewing conditions.
Calm, smooth. Lots of smoke in basin from Markleyville fire. South Lake Tahoe obscured; east-shore mountains barely visible.
Smooth, calm. Perfect viewing. Clear water.

Flat, calm. Sun slightly obscured by smoky haze. EXCELLENT viewing conditions. A 25,000 acre fire was just brought under control after about 5 days of burning in the Eldorado National Forest SW of the Tahoe basin.
Flat, calm. Bright, warm sun but lowering sun angle. Smoggy in basin. No wind. EXCELLENT viewing conditions.

Flat, calm. Sun obscured partially by stratus and cumulus clouds and showers moving in. Cloud cover is now ~80%. GOOD-to-EXCELLENT viewing conditions. Controlled burns were visible down near Sugar Pine Point and Rubicon probably in the state parks.
Ripples and light breeze from ESE. Sun covered by thin, high stratus. Cool. GOOD viewing conditions despite diffuse light and some sky reflection.
Ripples from the east and 1-2 kn breeze. Sky 90% overcast with high stratus. Sun hazy and becoming obscure. GOOD viewing conditions, but sun angle is low and the sun is partially obscured.
Flat, calm. Sun warm and slightly obscured by 80% high stratus and haze. No wind. EXCELLENT viewing conditions. Low sun angle.
Waves 1.5 ft from NW. Sky overcast. Much sky reflection. Sun hidden. FAIR viewing conditions.
Flat, calm. No clouds. Bright, warm sun. No wind. Light haze. Low sun angle. EXCELLENT viewing conditions.
Smooth swells. Sky hazy, but sun bright. Cold. Light, variable breeze. Low sun angle but EXCELLENT viewing conditions. Zooplankton sample has a green-yellow tinge (Dinobryon sp.).

Smooth ripples. Snowing heavily. No sun visible. But GOOD viewing conditions. Zooplankton sample almost colorless compared to yellow-green sample taken at MLTP station on 12-I-93. Upwelling here due to recent storms??
Flat, calm. Bright sun. Warm. Light haze to SW. EXCELLENT viewing conditions. There was snow, rain and strong SW winds for over a week before this LTP. Zooplankton sample has a greenish tinge.

Waves ~0.5 ft. Wind SW @5 kn. Gusts to 10 kn. Mostly cloudy with snow flurries up higher. Sun in and out. FAIR viewing conditions. Zooplankton sample has a greenish tinge due to a bloom of Dinobryon sp.
SW wind @5-10 kn. Waves 1 ft. Snowing moderately. FAIR viewing conditions. Zooplankton sample has a greenish tinge.
Flat, calm. EXCELLENT viewing conditions! Zooplankton sample has few phytoplankton in it.
Ripples and waves ~0.5 ft from SW wind @2-5 kn. Bright sun. GOOD viewing conditions. Zooplankton sample green with Dinobryon.

Flat, calm. Smooth ripples. Bright sun. Moderate in-basin smog. No wind or light breezes. A bloom is occurring: seen as "dust" in the water and reflection of light above the Secchi disk. Lots of algae in zooplankton sample (green) clogging net!

Light SE breeze. Ripples. Sun warm but slightly hazy from high, thin stratus. GOOD viewing conditions. Zooplankton sample is thick with algae. Water is a distinctly darker blue-emerald green color. Fluorescence indicates that most algae are in top 20 m.
Flat, calm. No clouds. Bright, warm sun. EXCELLENT viewing conditions. Water is blue-green in color. Lots of Dinobryon in zooplankton sample.
Rippled with SW breeze @2-3 mph. GOOD viewing conditions.

Waves ~0.75 ft. SW wind @~5 kn. Gusts @15 kn. Sky 95% cloud-covered @10,000 ft. Sun obscured. Raining. Lots of sky reflection. Showers. FAIR viewing conditions. Fewer algae in zooplankton sample than before.
Smooth ripples. Bright sun. EXCELLENT viewing conditions.
Flat, calm. Light sky reflection. Bright sun. EXCELLENT viewing conditions. Water is a blue-green color. Floating debris (bark, needles, etc.) on surface from stream runoff into lake.

Ripples from gusty winds. Moved as close to shore as possible to get a "deep" reading, if possible. GOOD-to-EXCELLENT viewing conditions. Water at Index Station is green...an algal bloom (due to all the runoff) is in progress.
Smooth ripples from NE. No wind. No clouds over sun. Bright and warm. EXCELLENT viewing conditions. Water is still an emerald-green or "teal" color but a bit clearer than last time.
Flat, calm. Warm, bright sun. Clear sky. EXCELLENT viewing conditions.
Rippled. Wind SW, gusty @2-10 kn. Bright sun. GOOD viewing conditions.
Smooth ripples. No wind. Bright, warm sun. Moderate in-basin smog. No clouds anywhere. EXCELLENT viewing conditions.
Smooth swells due to boat wakes. Clear sky. Warm sun. No wind. Smoggy. EXCELLENT viewing conditions.
Choppy. SW winds to 20 mph. Very gusty. Tried to keep line perpendicular by backing down.
Winds SW @10 kn. Chop. Not good viewing.
Boat wakes. Waves ~0.5 m. Light E breeze. Sky clear over sun. Bright and warm. GOOD viewing conditions.
Ripples. Sky clear of clouds for awhile. Breeze SW @2-10 mph, gusty. GOOD viewing conditions.
Flat, calm. Bright sun. Warm. Light, high, thin stratus. No wind. Light smog. EXCELLENT viewing conditions. Water clarity has increased significantly!
NW breeze @3-5 kn. Ripples. Bright sun. GOOD viewing conditions.

NE wind @1-2 kn. Waves ~1 ft. Sky clear. Sun bright. GOOD viewing conditions. There's a large (visible to the naked eye) colonial alga (Uroglenopsis) showing up...not a lot, but a few per 10 ml in the sub-surface samples (e.g. 5, 10 m).
Flat, calm. Warm, hazy sun. 100% high, thin stratus. Moderate in-basin smog. A lot of "dust" (Uroglenopsis?) between illuminated Secchi disk and the boat. EXCELLENT viewing conditions.
Ripples and light, easterly breeze. GOOD viewing conditions. Uroglenopsis still very abundant (blooming profusely) above Secchi. Heavy smoke in basin from controlled burns.

Smooth ripples from SE. Sky clear. Sun bright and warm. Light breeze. GOOD-to-EXCELLENT viewing conditions. Uroglenopsis is still very prevalent in upper water layers down to about 20 m. Smoke in the basin from State Park controlled burns.

Waves from north ~1.5 ft. Wind @2-3 kn. Sky clear. Bright sun. Cool. FAIR-to-GOOD viewing conditions. Uroglenopsis still prevails! It is now found much deeper in the water column. Visual inspection shows colonies as far down as at least 105 m!
Snowing heavily. No sun. FAIR viewing conditions.
Flat, calm. Bright sun. No clouds or wind. Moderate in-basin smog. Cool. EXCELLENT viewing conditions. Uroglenopsis is still predominant in surface waters and color is greenish-blue!

Westerly, cool breeze. Gusty @2-10 kn. 20% cumulus. Bright sun. Ripples. GOOD viewing conditions. Uroglenopsis is still dominant and zooplankton almost non-existent (are they starving due to presence of non-edible, large Uroglenopsis colonies??).

Flat, calm. EXCELLENT viewing conditions. Uroglenopsis still very abundant! It's so numerous in some fluorescence samples that only a range could be measured. One 10 m sample had ~100 colonies in the test tube. The other didn't have as many. Extreme patchiness!

Ripples and small waves ~0.75 ft. Wind SW and gusty @2-10 kn (mostly lower speeds). Sun in and out of clouds intermittently. Cold. Snow flurries. FAIR-to-GOOD viewing conditions. Uroglenopsis is still predominant, especially in surface waters.

Ripples from the SE with ~2 kn breeze. High stratus overcast 95%. Sun shining weakly through clouds with ceiling ~12,000 ft+. GOOD viewing conditions. Uroglenopsis still prevalent and looks like "dust" in the water when viewed in reflective light above Secchi disk.

Flat, calm. Bright, warm sun. No wind. Some thin high haze. EXCELLENT viewing conditions. Uroglenopsis is still quite visible! The colonies were observed to rise to the top of a bottle over a several hour period.
Flat, calm. Bright sun. EXCELLENT viewing conditions. No wind. Uroglenopsis still very abundant.
Flat, calm. Bright sun. Light haze. ~15% high, scattered cirrostratus. Low in-basin moderate smog. EXCELLENT viewing conditions. Uroglenopsis is again very abundant!
Smooth easterly swells. No clouds. Bright sun. GOOD viewing conditions. Uroglenopsis carries on, and on, and ... but there does seem to be fewer in fluorescence samples.
Flat, calm. EXCELLENT viewing conditions. Uroglenopsis is again quite abundant!
Smooth NE swells ~1 ft. Bright, warm sun. No clouds. Warm. GOOD-to-EXCELLENT viewing conditions. Uroglenopsis is finally on the decline!
Flat, calm. Warm, sunny. No wind. 40% cumulus clouds. Nice. EXCELLENT viewing conditions.
Waves ~1 ft. Cold. Windy. 100% cloud cover. Snow is threatening. FAIR-to-GOOD viewing conditions.
Smooth swells. Sun shining through the high stratus which is changing quickly. Warm. No wind. GOOD-to-EXCELLENT viewing conditions despite increasing cloud cover and sky reflection.
Waves ~0.5 to 1 ft. Wind SW @2-15 kn and gusty. Sun was behind high, moderate stratus, changing slightly but now brighter. Gusty winds made readings difficult. FAIR-to-GOOD viewing conditions.
Ripples with SW wind @2-5 kn. Gusts to 15 kn. Bright sun. Warm. No clouds. GOOD viewing conditions.
Smooth 1 ft swells from NE but now calmer. No clouds. Warm sun. Light in-basin smog. No wind.
Flat, calm. No wind. Very warm. No clouds. Moderate in-basin smog. EXCELLENT viewing conditions.
Smooth surface. No clouds over sun. Warm. Bright sun. ~15% high alto cirrus clouds off to NW. EXCELLENT viewing conditions.
SW wind @10-15 kn. Waves to 1 ft. Bright, warm sun. No clouds over sun. FAIR-to-GOOD viewing conditions.
NE breeze @1-2 kn. Warm, hazy sun due to smoke in the basin. Waves ~0.75 ft. No high clouds. GOOD viewing conditions.
Smooth swells. 50% high cloud cover over sun. GOOD-to-EXCELLENT viewing conditions.
Flat, calm. Sun now out from behind cloud and bright light in-basin smog. EXCELLENT viewing conditions. Strong SW winds @10-40 kn the previous 3-4 days.
Light NE breeze. Ripples earlier (calmer now). Bright, warm sun. No clouds. Moderate in-basin smog. EXCELLENT viewing conditions. Strong NE winds @5-15 kn the previous day.
Flat, calm surface. EXCELLENT viewing conditions. Strong NE winds during the previous 3-4 days.

Smooth ripples. Bright, warm sun. Some high, thin stratus around sun. Light variable breezes earlier...now calmer. GOOD-to-EXCELLENT viewing conditions. Smog in basin due to controlled burns in D.L. Bliss and Sugar Pine Point State Parks.
NE breeze @1-2 kn with ripple. Bright sun. Cool. GOOD-to-EXCELLENT viewing conditions.
Waves ~1 ft with wind @3 kn, both from NNW. Sky 95% overcast with snow showers around basin. GOOD viewing conditions. Strong SW wind yesterday @30-40 kn with gusts to 50-60 kn.
Smooth ripples. Some light clouds passing in front of sun occasionally. Cool. Light breezes. Moderate in-basin smog. Sun is past its peak. GOOD-to-EXCELLENT viewing conditions.
Rippled. 5 kn SW wind. 100% overcast. Snowing intermittently. FAIR-to-GOOD viewing conditions. SW winds strong at times the previous 3-4 days.
Glassy calm. EXCELLENT conditions for viewing (except for fog).
Flat, calm. No wind. Bright sun despite low sun angle. EXCELLENT viewing conditions. Strong NE winds 10-20 kn yesterday.

Snowing lightly. No sun visible. SW breeze @1-2 kn. Ripples. GOOD viewing conditions (except for sky reflection). First break in series of incessant storms lasting ~ 2 wk that brought rain and snow, and strong winds (15-40 kn) at times, to lake level.
Smooth surface. 100% cloud cover and sky reflection. Weak sun. GOOD viewing conditions.
Glassy calm. Fog beginning to lift with sun now brighter through the fog. No wind. Cool. Sun beginning to shine. GOOD-to-EXCELLENT viewing conditions.
Clear sky. Warm sun. No clouds. Flat, calm. Some "dust" in the water (Uroglenopsis ?). EXCELLENT viewing conditions.
Smooth ripples. Partial sun. Cool NE breeze and sky reflections but GOOD viewing conditions.
Ripples ~0.5 ft from SW. Partially covered sun. SW wind @3 kn. Some sky reflection. GOOD viewing conditions.
Flat, calm. Bright, warm sun. No wind. EXCELLENT viewing conditions. Water has a slight greenish-blue cast to it.
Smooth ripples from NE. Warm sun. Light NE breeze. High, thin stratus over sun. Calm. GOOD-to-EXCELLENT viewing conditions.
Flat, calm. Warm, bright sun. No clouds. Light in-basin smog. EXCELLENT viewing conditions! Water has definite greenish-blue color.
Flat, calm. Bright sun but some thin, high stratus. No wind. ~10% low cumulus. Moderate in-basin smog. EXCELLENT viewing conditions.

Bright, warm sun. No clouds in front of sun. No wind. ~10% low cumulus ringing the basin. Light in-basin smog. EXCELLENT viewing conditions. Water definitely has a bluish-green cast. Has a "bloom" started? First nice day after 3 wks foul weather.

Smooth ripples. No wind. Cumulus clouds passing over sun making readings difficult [:(]. ~40% cloud cover now moving in from NE. GOOD-to-EXCELLENT viewing conditions when the sun is out. Lake transparency is definitely dropping.
Waves ~1-1.5 ft from the east. Cool, 2-5 kn breeze. Clouds passing over sun making readings difficult. Cloud cover and sky reflection. FAIR-to-GOOD viewing conditions.
Wind SW @10-15 kn. Gusts to 20 kn. Small whitecaps. Sky clear.

Smooth swells. Bright sun. No wind. EXCELLENT viewing conditions. "Particles" visible over Secchi disc. Very warm weather past week brought west shore streams to their peaks causing higher turbidity and giving a distinct green color to the lake.
Waves ~1 ft. SW wind @5-10 kn. FAIR-to-GOOD viewing conditions. Sunny and cool.
Smooth ripples. Light breezes. Moderate-to-heavy, in-basin smog. Warm, bright sun. No clouds nearby. EXCELLENT viewing conditions.
Smooth ripples. Bright, warm sun. No wind. EXCELLENT viewing conditions.
EXCELLENT viewing conditions. Some "particles" seen above white disk--zooplankton? Strong SW winds @15-25 kn 2 days ago.
Smooth ripples. 80% high cloud cover over the sun. No wind. GOOD viewing conditions. Lots of "particles" (zooplankton?) visible over Secchi disk reflection.

Smooth swells. Warm, bright sun. No clouds or wind. Light-to-moderate smog. GOOD-to-EXCELLENT viewing conditions. Lots of "particles" noticeable in shallow water reflective light above the white Secchi disk. They are thought to be a rotifer "bloom".
Flat, calm. No wind. Warm, bright sun. Moderate-to-heavy smog. No clouds. EXCELLENT viewing conditions. Still lots of "particles" (rotifers?) visible above Secchi disk.
Waves ~0.75 ft. Gusty SW winds @2-10 kn. Cool. No clouds. Bright sun. FAIR-to-GOOD viewing conditions.

Smooth ripples. Bright, warm sun. ~10% distant and high cirrus. Light, variable breezes. Light-to-moderate in-basin smog. GOOD-to-EXCELLENT viewing conditions. Very strong, steady NE winds @15-25 kn previous day. Lake is clearing up a bit.
Ripples and 0.5 ft waves due to ESE winds @1-2 kn. Fairly heavy in-basin smog visible now that fog has burned off. Bright, warm sun. No clouds. EXCELLENT viewing conditions.
Flat, calm. Bright sun. No wind. Warm. EXCELLENT viewing conditions.
Flat, calm. Cool sun. Slightly overcast with high stratus. Light breezes-variable directions. EXCELLENT viewing conditions.
Waves ~0.5 ft. SW wind gusty @5-20 kn. Small, intermittent whitecaps. Weak sunlight coming through 99% cloud cover. Raining. FAIR-to-GOOD viewing conditions.
Waves 0.5 ft from NW wind @3 kn. 98% cloud cover. FAIR-to-GOOD viewing conditions. Sun weak.
Flat, calm. Bright sun. No clouds. EXCELLENT viewing conditions.
FAIR-to-GOOD viewing conditions. Sky reflection from clouds. Ripples. SE wind @3 kn.

Smooth swells. Bright sun. Cool. Light breezes-variable direction. No clouds over sun. Light in-basin smog. Calm. EXCELLENT viewing conditions. Preceded by fast moving storm yesterday that brought very strong SW winds from 30 kn (gusts to 50 kn).
Sun moving in and out of clouds as ceiling lowers and snow showers start. Cold. NE wind @~3 kn. Ripples. Sky reflection and partial sun gives FAIR-to-GOOD viewing conditions. Lake is clearing up.
Smooth and calm. No wind. Moderate sun through high, thin stratus clouds. Cool.

Ripples and SW breeze @2-3 kn. Bright sun at the moment. GOOD viewing conditions. Preceded by almost 6 days of continuous wind, rain, and snow. Best Secchi reading this year. A week of moderate-to-strong SW winds may have led to westshore upwelling.
Smooth and calm. No wind. Bright sun. No clouds. EXCELLENT viewing conditions. Very strong, gusting winds 2 days ago.
Ripples and light breeze from SE. High stratus moving in to cover sun. Still it's warm and bright. Light in-basin smog. EXCELLENT viewing conditions.
Ripples. SW breeze @2-3 kn. 100% overcast. Rain and graupel (snow). Sky reflection. FAIR-to-GOOD viewing conditions. Preceded by 2 days of strong NE wind.
Smooth swells from E. Bright, warm sun. No clouds, but some high, thin haze and light in-basin smog. GOOD-to-EXCELLENT viewing conditions. Snow showers and strong winds 4 days ago.
Windy SSW @10-15 kn with higher gusts. Cool. Partly cloudy ~50% cumulus. Waves

Very strong WSW winds @30-50 mph yesterday (and stronger gusts) for ~12-16 h. Upwelling event along W. shore brought up very clear water. Secchi reading taken twice and confirmed by Judy Hildinger. Few zooplankton, deep light penetration, low fluorescence. EXCELLENT viewing conditions.

SW wind @3-5 kn with gusts to 10 kn. Bright sun. ~40% high cumulus clouds. Warm. Waves and ripples ~0.5-1 ft. GOOD viewing conditions. Clarity has reduced markedly since the last LTP. Water is cloudy and greener.
Smooth. Light easterly breeze. Warm. Sun bright but behind high haze and moisture. Calm. EXCELLENT viewing conditions. Preceded by 5 days continuous rain with strong SW winds at times.

Smooth ripples from SE with 2 kn breeze. Hazy sun behind moderate in-basin smog. Warm. Some high, thin stratus (~15%). GOOD-to-EXCELLENT viewing conditions. A few large algal colonies (Uroglenopsis ?) seen in fluorescence tube.
SW breeze @5 kn, increasing quickly. Warm and sunny. GOOD-to-EXCELLENT viewing conditions.
Looks like a few Uroglenopsis may be present?
Flat, calm. Warm and muggy. No wind. 35% low cumulus clouds. Excellent viewing conditions. Lots of debris and pine pollen on the lake surface.
Waves ~0.5 ft. Bright sun. No clouds. Winds SW and gusty from 2-15 kn. Warming. GOOD viewing despite gusty winds. Strong SW winds yesterday for about 2/3 of the day.
Smooth swells. No wind, calm. Small cumulus clouds building. EXCELLENT viewing conditions. Some forest fire smoke in the basin the past week.
Swells and ripples from SW or NE as thunderstorms are building overhead. GOOD viewing conditions.
Flat, calm. Warm, bright sun through smoky haze. EXCELLENT viewing conditions. Smoky from Yosemite and Clear Lake fires (>500,000 acres burned).
Waves ~1.5 ft. SW wind gusty @10-25 kn. FAIR-to-GOOD viewing conditions. No clouds. Bright sun. A little smoke left in the basin from California fires.

Ripples. Bright sun. ~15% __?__. Cool. Easterly swells. Light in-basin smog after yesterday's rain. Light breezes. Some particles visible in water over reflected light above Secchi. EXCELLENT viewing conditions.
Light ripples from SE and 1-2 kn breeze. Hazy sun with thin, high stratus cover (~75%). Smoky from Sugar Pine Pt. State Park controlled burn. GOOD-to-EXCELLENT viewing conditions.

Smooth ripples. No wind. Bright sun with no clouds. But smoke from controlled burns at Sugar Pine Pt. State Park spreading over the lake and Index station. Lots of "particulates" in the water. EXCELLENT viewing conditions.

Swells at ~1 ft from east with light breeze and ripples. Bright warming sun. No clouds. But smoky haze in-basin from controlled burns at Sugar Pine Pt. State Park. Lots of particulate matter in Secchi reflection. GOOD-to-EXCELLENT viewing conditions.
Ripples. Sky grey with 100% high, thickening overcast. FAIR-to-GOOD viewing conditions.
Flat, calm. Bright, warming sun. No wind. Smoke and haze in the basin from the controlled burns on USFS and state park lands. GOOD-to-EXCELLENT viewing conditions.
Ripples and smooth swells from SE. Bright sun but low angle. No clouds over sun. Cool. GOOD viewing conditions.
Breeze at 2-5 kn, variable directions. Ripples. Cloud cover increasing to 95% stratus and sun not visible. GOOD viewing conditions.

Flat, calm. Preceded by over 10 days of continuous strong winds, rain, and snow bringing well over 10" precipitation to the basin. Warm sun shining through high, moderate stratus clouds. Light, variable breezes. Nice. EXCELLENT viewing conditions.
Waves ~2 ft. Rain and snow blowing almost horizontally. SW wind @15 kn. Gusts to 25 kn. Very weak sun peeking through. Only FAIR viewing conditions.
Snowing moderately. No sun visible. Visibility ~0.5 mi. Lots of sky reflection. FAIR-to-GOOD viewing conditions.
100% overcast. A few snow flurries. Sun obscured behind stratus clouds ~1500' above lake. Light, variable breezes and ripples. Lots of sky reflections. GOOD viewing conditions otherwise.
Flat, calm. No wind. Light rain and snow. 100% cloud overcast. GOOD-to-EXCELLENT viewing conditions.
6" ripples on surface and SW gusts just coming up @10 kn. Lots of "dust" and some foam on surface. GOOD viewing conditions.
Windy with gusts 5-15 kn and waves to 0.5 ft. Sun slightly obscured by high clouds. GOOD viewing conditions.
EXCELLENT viewing conditions. No wind. 80% high, moderate stratus over sun.
Waves ~0.75 ft. SW breeze @5 kn. 80% cumulus with snow flurries but sky clear over sun. GOOD viewing conditions.
Smooth swells. Bright sun (clouds not over sun). Light east breeze. EXCELLENT viewing conditions.
1 ft. swells. Gusty SSW winds @2-10 kn. Sun in and out behind clouds. Warm. GOOD viewing conditions.
Flat, calm. No wind. Bright sun. Some haze. Warm. EXCELLENT viewing conditions.
Flat, calm. Bright, warm sun. ~10% cumulus clouds off in distance. No wind. EXCELLENT viewing conditions. Water is light greenish-blue.

Smooth ripples. Sun obscured by high stratus clouds. SW wind @5 kn. Lots of sky reflection. Surface has some pollen on it. GOOD viewing conditions. First use of black matte finish 60-cm diameter Secchi disk (vs. standard white matte 26-cm Secchi disk).
Waves ~0.5 ft. Lots of sky reflection. Raining lightly. 100% cloud cover. SW wind @5-10 kn. FAIR viewing conditions.
Fog dissipating. Bright, warm sun. Light in-basin smog. Calm. 20% low cumulus around basin. No sky reflection overhead. Nice. No wind. EXCELLENT viewing conditions.
Waves 0.5 ft. Lots of sky reflection. 100% low cloud cover with rain and hail. FAIR viewing conditions.
Waves ~1 ft. SW breezes gusty. GOOD viewing conditions.
Flat, calm. Warm, bright sun. No wind or clouds. Moderate in-basin smog. Cumulus. EXCELLENT viewing conditions.
Wind gusts SW @15 kn. Ripples. Bright sun. EXCELLENT viewing conditions.
Smooth boat swells. Bright, warm sun. Light breezes and ripples. No clouds. Moderate in-basin smoke and haze. Water is a light blue-green color. EXCELLENT viewing conditions.
SW winds gusting to 15-20(?) kn. Small whitecaps. 2 ft. waves. Sunny. GOOD viewing conditions.
Ripples. NW breeze @2-5 kn. 90% cloud cover. Sky reflection. FAIR-to-GOOD viewing conditions. "Low light" during black disk reading.
Flat, calm. Sunny. No wind. EXCELLENT viewing conditions.
Overcast with sun hidden by rain clouds. Light breezes. EXCELLENT viewing conditions. Prescribed burning has started its fall cycle at Sugar Pine Pt. State Park.
GOOD viewing conditions. Light NE breeze. Sunny. Waves ~1-1.5 ft with ripples. Cool.
Flat, calm, etc. Warm, bright sun. No clouds or wind. Smoky in the basin (moderate-to-light here; heavy on east shore). Some dead zooplankton on the surface. EXCELLENT viewing conditions.
Smooth swells. Smoky skies from prescribed burn at Sugar Pine Pt. No clouds. Warming and clearing. No wind. Sunny. EXCELLENT viewing conditions. "Particles" visible in water.
Waves ~0.75 ft. Sun in and out behind clouds. SW winds @5-10 kn. Cool. FAIR-to-GOOD viewing conditions. Smoky from prescribed burns.
Ripples and SW breeze @5 kn. Much sky reflection with sun behind clouds. FAIR-to-GOOD viewing conditions. Mostly clear in basin except for smoke from prescribed burns.
Small ripples. Light, variable breezes. Bright sun. Warming. Approximately 40% cumulus and high stratus clouds. GOOD viewing conditions.
NNE wind @5 kn. Clear sky. Cold. Low sun angle. Waves ~1 ft. Water has a greenish-blue tint to it. GOOD viewing conditions.
Calm. Smooth, small swells. Sun bright. Approximately 30% stratus clouds disappearing. Light NE breeze. Warming. Sun angle quite low. Water a greenish-blue. EXCELLENT viewing conditions.
Flat, calm, no wind. High, moderate stratus passing in front of sun. Warming as time goes by. EXCELLENT viewing conditions. Preceded by a 15-day cold period with NE winds @10-30 kn.
Flat, calm. GOOD-to-EXCELLENT viewing conditions despite lack of sun thus low light levels.
Waves 0.75 ft from west. Sun weak. Sky reflections. Wind from W @5 kn. FAIR-to-GOOD viewing conditions.
Snowing moderately. Visibility only ~100 yd. No sun visible. No shadows. No wind, calm surface. White sky reflection but GOOD viewing conditions.
Breeze @5kn from NW. Ripples. GOOD viewing conditions despite cloud cover. The lake is clearing up and this is the first time for a long while that the Secchi depth has been >25 m.

Smooth ripples. Bright sun. Warming. Light, variable breezes. EXCELLENT viewing conditions. Lake is clearing rapidly, possibly due to 1) low light levels --> decreased photosynthesis (many storms and lots of cloud cover) and/or 2) deep mixing.
Much sky reflection. NW breeze @2 kn. Ripples. GOOD viewing conditions.
Waves ~ 1 ft from SW. Wind variable @5-15 kn. Cloud cover ~98%. Much sky reflection. FAIR-to-GOOD viewing conditions.
Some sky reflection with ~60% cloud cover. Cold NW wind @10 kn with 1-1.5 ft waves. FAIR-to-GOOD viewing conditions.
Light easterly breeze and ripples. Warm and sunny but very hazy. GOOD viewing conditions.
Smooth ripples from SE. Light SE breeze. Low cumulus clouds ~1000 ft above lake. 100% cover. Very weak sun. Warming. GOOD viewing conditions except for low light.
South winds @2 kn, gusts to 10 kn. Clear, cloudless sky. Cool breeze. Waves 0.5 ft. Light in-basin smog.
Flat, calm, cloudless, and sunny. EXCELLENT viewing conditions! Nice.
Smooth ripples. Sun obscured under darkening, threatening skies. Light NE breeze. Warm. 95% cloud cover.
EXCELLENT viewing conditions. No clouds over sun. Hazy. Warm and calm.
Waves and breeze SW @5-10 kn just coming up. No clouds. Warm and sunny. GOOD viewing conditions. Some waves but sunny and clear.
Smooth swells and ripples. Light breezes. Warm and sunny with no clouds. Moderate in-basin smog. EXCELLENT viewing conditions. Lots of pine pollen everywhere (~3-4 weeks later than normal).
Waves 0.75 ft. SE breeze @2-3 kn. 95% high stratus and cumulus clouds. Warm. Sun not visible through cloud cover. Some sky reflection. GOOD viewing conditions. Not much pollen left on lake surface.
Very warm. Calm. Clear. No wind. Moderate, in-basin smog. No clouds at all. EXCELLENT viewing conditions.
Waves ~1-1.5 ft. Sunny. Cool. No clouds. Wire angle ~20-40 degrees due to winds. Wind SW @10-15 kn. Whitecaps. Wave reflections. FAIR-to-GOOD viewing conditions.
Warm. Windless, calm with smooth swells. Some wispy clouds around ~40%. EXCELLENT viewing conditions.
FAIR-to-GOOD viewing conditions due to cloud cover now ~75%. SW wind and ripples. Gusting to 10-15 kn, etc.
Easterly breeze @2-3 kn. Bright, warming sun. Waves and swells were 1.5-2 ft, then down to 1 ft. Now calmer. EXCELLENT viewing conditions. Sun angle beginning to drop.
Ripples from SW breeze @10 kn. Intermittent sun through clouds. 60% cloud cover. FAIR viewing conditions.
Calm. Warm and sunny. EXCELLENT viewing conditions.
Smooth ripples and light SW breeze @~3 kn. 98% cloud cover. Cool. GOOD viewing conditions.
Rough. Sun out but large waves (~2.5-3 ft). FAIR-to-GOOD viewing conditions. Too rough for black Secchi reading! Swell surge would make it a "taco".
Clouds over sun. Much sky-cloud reflection. Light breezes. Smooth ripples. Previous 3-4 days --> strong SW winds @20-40 mph with gusts to 60-70 at lake level.
Flat, calm. Low sun angle. Sunny and cold. EXCELLENT viewing conditions.
Flat, calm. Weak sun. Very foggy. No wind. Water has a blue-green cast to it. EXCELLENT viewing conditions. Uroglenopsis americana has returned (especially common in the shallower depths, 0-30 m).
Flat, calm. Warm sun. Moderate in-basin smog and haze. Very thin, high stratus. Cool. EXCELLENT viewing conditions. Lots of "dust" (Uroglenopsis?) in water. Water blue-green.

Gusty SW wind @5-20 kn. Ripples with whitecaps. No sun. Hailing lightly. Ceiling ~500 ft above lake. FAIR-to-GOOD viewing conditions due to low cloud ceiling and 100% overcast. Water very clear (good conditions could have produced a possible near-record value).
Flat, calm. Sun slightly obscured by high stratus clouds. EXCELLENT viewing conditions. Lots of "particulate matter" in upper waters as seen over reflected sun-lit Secchi disk.
Cold, 5-10 kn SW breeze. 1-ft waves. Clouds over sun. Much sky reflection. FAIR-to-GOOD viewing conditions.
SE breeze and ripples. Sunny and mostly clear. EXCELLENT viewing conditions.
GOOD viewing conditions. Cool, westerly breeze and ripples @3 kn. Bright sun.
Some sky reflection.; otherwise EXCELLENT viewing conditions. Cool. Light breeze from SE. Ripples.
GOOD viewing conditions. Sun bright. Surface rippled with 1 kn E breeze.
Snowing moderately. Lots of sky reflection with 90% cloud cover and weak sun. 0.5 ft waves. FAIR-to-GOOD viewing conditions. Lake may have remixed again?
Flat, calm. Sunny. EXCELLENT viewing conditions.
Rough. Waves to 2.5-3 ft due to NE winds now @20 kn. Sun out. FAIR viewing conditions. Didn't take "black" Secchi depth reading because of rough water.
NE breeze @5 kn. Cooling. Thickening clouds over sun. FAIR-to-GOOD viewing conditions.
Flat, calm. Warm sun. No clouds. Some high haze. No wind. EXCELLENT viewing conditions. Water is a cloudy, blue-green.

Gusty SW breeze @10-15 kn. Ripples. Sky reflection due to 60% cumulus cover. Clouds passing quickly in front of sun due to SW winds. FAIR viewing conditions. Lots of pollen in surface waters. Water is a cloudy, greenish-blue color.

Smooth swells. Calm. Warm and sunny. No clouds over sun but some stratus moving in from the west. Smoke increasing overhead from E shore controlled burn. EXCELLENT viewing conditions. Secchi reading better than past several LTPs due to good viewing conditions. Some loose clumps of pollen and periphyton.

Water is emerald green and "cloudy". Light E breeze @1-3 kn. Ripples. Some cloud cover. GOOD viewing conditions. Some pollen on surface and down in water column. Prescribed burn @ Spooner Summit. Smoke blowing to NE.
Smooth swells ~0.5 ft from boat wakes. Calm. Warm, sunny. No wind. Light smog. EXCELLENT viewing conditions.

Warm. Calm, smooth ripples from boat wakes. Muggy. 80% cover of high, cumulostratus clouds obscuring sun. Heavy in-basin smog; smoky. EXCELLENT viewing conditions. Lots of dead insects on the surface (midges -- Diptera?).
Light breezes and small ripples. No clouds but heavy in-basin smog from fires out of basin. Warm and sunny. EXCELLENT viewing conditions. Many small dead insects on surface.
Smooth ripples as rain has stopped. Light SW breezes. Sun showing intermittently through breaking clouds. FAIR viewing conditions due to cloud cover and sky reflection. Ripples 6".
Sun momentarily out. Smooth swells. Warm, sunny. GOOD-to-EXCELLENT viewing conditions.
Smooth, 1 ft. swells and ripples from ESE. Bright sun. No clouds. Some haze. GOOD-to-EXCELLENT viewing conditions.
Water blue-green. Ripples. Sun intermittent as clouds build into the basin. Very smoky and hazy in basin. GOOD-to-EXCELLENT viewing conditions.
Flat, calm. Warm and sunny but smoggy. No wind. EXCELLENT viewing conditions.
GOOD viewing. Sky clear, sunny. Ripples. Breeze SW @5 kn. Water is blue-green. Still very smoky from many N. California fires.
Nice. Warming and sunny. Smoggy. Flat, calm. EXCELLENT viewing conditions. Smoky with moderate-to--heavy smog from controlled burns and fires in California.
Some thin, high stratus between lake and sun. Warm. Flat, calm. Sunny. Glassy. EXCELLENT viewing conditions. Moderate in-basin smog from a controlled burn at Incline.

Flat, calm. Cool. High. thickening stratus overcast (~85%). Light breezes. Sun shining through moderately. GOOD viewing conditions except for overcast sky. Increasing light-to-moderate in-basin smog. Controlled burn above Carnelian Bay.
Rough with whitecaps. No sun. FAIR viewing conditions. Light smog from controlled burns.
Waves 2 ft. Cloud-sky reflection and low sun angle gave only FAIR-to-GOOD viewing conditions.
Rough. Waves @3 ft. East wind @ 10 kn. Clear and sunny but only FAIR viewing conditions.
Calm with light NW breeze and ripples. Moderately thick, high, changeable stratus over sun. Cool. Moderate in-basin smog. Some white, reflective sky cloud cover. EXCELLENT viewing conditions.

High, thin stratus over sun. Gusty winds and 0.5 ft waves. But GOOD viewing conditions. Strong SW winds during previous 4.5 days resulting in major upwelling event. Lake noticeably clearer even in early morning light.
EXCELLENT viewing conditions. Cool and sunny. Flat, calm. Water is blue-green.
Flat, calm. No wind. Sky reflection from cloud cover. Weak sun, but EXCELLENT viewing conditions.

Cloud cover 90%. Cold, westerly breeze @3 kn. Ripples. GOOD viewing conditions (except for sky reflection). Some upwelling appears to have happened again from very strong winds recently (gusts SW @50-60 kn on lake).
Ripples with NW breeze @2-3 kn. High, thick clouds (100%). GOOD viewing conditions.
Rough. Whitecaps ~1-2 ft. Cloud ceiling now at lake level. Raining. SW gusty wind @30 kn. FAIR viewing conditions.
GOOD viewing conditions but 80% high cloud cover. Small waves and ripples. Moderate light.
Calm. Sunny. Little sky reflection. Water cloudy, blue-green. EXCELLENT viewing conditions.
Calm surface. Raining. But low light and much sky reflection. FAIR-to-GOOD viewing conditions.
Ripples. No clouds. SW breeze @2 kn. Cooling. GOOD viewing conditions.
Water is greenish-blue. SW breeze @5 kn. Ripples. Some sky cover. FAIR-to-GOOD viewing conditions. Black Secchi disk was repainted with flat black spray paint before this measurement.
Snowing. Calm, but sun obscured and much sky reflection. GOOD viewing conditions.

Choppy with 1 ft. waves and gusty winds. No clouds. Waves gave FAIR-to-GOOD viewing conditions. Water is a greenish-blue. Surface temperature still quite cool...perhaps we had another seiche/upwelling event.
FAIR-to-GOOD viewing conditions. High cloud sky reflections. Small waves.
Waves ~1 ft. Sunny and warm. GOOD viewing conditions. Lots of pollen on lake surface.
Smooth swells ~0.5 ft. Bright, warm sun. No clouds over sun. Hazy with thunderstorm cumulus building to south. EXCELLENT viewing conditions. Still some pollen on the surface.
Flat, calm. EXCELLENT viewing conditions.
EXCELLENT viewing conditions. Flat, calm. Sunny. No clouds or wind.
GOOD viewing conditions. East wind @5 kn. Boat waves 1 ft. Bright, warm sun. No clouds.
Boat wakes ~1.5 ft. Light breezes SW with ripples. Some thin cirrus clouds passing over the sun. GOOD viewing conditions.
Gusty south winds @ 10-20 kn. A few cumulus clouds. Cool and sunny. Whitecaps and 1 ft. waves. Wire angle. GOOD viewing conditions in lee side shadow of boat.
Smooth swells from E ~1ft. Warm, sunny. Light breezes and ripples. EXCELLENT viewing conditions.
Smooth ripples. Warm and sunny. No wind. Hazy with moderate smog. 5% stratus off to the east. EXCELLENT viewing conditions.

FAIR-to-GOOD viewing conditions in shallower water near shore (sheltered from some of the wind). Weather deteriorating in front of incoming cold storm which threatens to bring snow to lake level. Rough with SW winds in gusts. Rapidly passing clouds.
Flat, calm. Warm, sunny. Sky clear. Great profiling conditions. EXCELLENT viewing conditions.
FAIR-to-GOOD viewing conditions. Sky reflection from cloud cover. South wind waves 1 ft.
Smooth ripples. Lower sun angle. ~30% high, thin stratus. Calm and sunny. Sky clear over sun. Light in-basin smog. EXCELLENT viewing conditions.
SW wind @10 kn. Waves ~1 ft. Low sun angle. GOOD to FAIR viewing conditions.
Flat, calm. Sun breaking through clouds. EXCELLENT viewing conditions.
Flat, calm. Warming, sunny. No clouds. Smooth swells. EXCELLENT viewing conditions!
Flat, calm. High moderate stratus overcast over sun. No wind. Moderate smog. Low sun angle.
SW breeze rising. High stratus cover thickening. Getting cooler. GOOD viewing conditions but becoming darker and breezy.
Flat, calm. Some high cloud reflection but EXCELLENT viewing conditions. Secchi depth has increased somewhat. NE winds @ 10-30 kn previous 3-4 days.
Large swells @ 2.5-3 ft. E wind @ 5-10 kn making for FAIR-to-GOOD viewing conditions.
E wind rising to 10 kn again with 1.5 ft whitecaps. Sky overcast. FAIR-to-GOOD viewing conditions.
Ripples from NW ~0.5 ft. Sunny. Cold. GOOD-to-EXCELLENT viewing conditions. Continually stormy for 4-5 days prior. Water clarity increasing as the lake mixes.
Waves from E @1.5 ft. Wind @5-10 kn. Sun in and out of 95% cumulus cloud cover with 10-15 kn wind. Sky reflection 100%. No sun visible. FAIR-to-GOOD viewing conditions.
Swells from NE. Cool with 2-3 kn breeze. GOOD viewing conditions.
High, thin stratus moving over sun. Calm. Warm and sunny. High, moderate cloud cover ~40%. EXCELLENT viewing conditions.

Smooth swells from the east. Warming and sunny. No clouds over sun. Light smog. EXCELLENT viewing conditions. Some more mixing may have occurred over the past several days due to some strong SW or NE winds.

Flat, calm. Warm and sunny. No clouds over sun. EXCELLENT viewing conditions. Significant amount of Gobi Desert dust and haze in the basin (from China/Mongolia dust storms) the previous week before a storm cleared it out.
Warm, bright sun through high, thin, uniform haze. No wind. Glassy calm. EXCELLENT viewing conditions. Water seems to be a "cloudy" blue.
Flat, calm. High, thin, stratus clouds. Warm and sunny. No wind. Smoggy. Repainted the black Secchi disk before this measurement.
Warm and sunny. High, thin, stratus and cirrus. Smooth E swells 1 ft. Hazy. EXCELLENT viewing conditions. Smoky from 4500 acre Susanville fire.
Breezy with 6" ripples. Gusty SW wind @3-10 kn. Warm and sunny. GOOD-to-EXCELLENT viewing conditions.
Ripples from gusty SW winds. Cloud cover 90%. FAIR viewing conditions. Most of the smoke from the Martis fire (6/17) kept out of basin by prevailing SW-->NE winds.
Breezy and gusty SW wind @10-15 kn. Heavy cloud cover. Cool. No sun visible. FAIR viewing conditions.
Flat, calm (except for boat wakes). Warm and sunny. Cloudless but smoggy. EXCELLENT viewing conditions! Lake is quite clear for this time of year! :)
Calm, warm, sunny. No waves except boat swells. Light in-basin smog. EXCELLENT viewing conditions.
High, thin clouds over sun. No wind. Warm. Smoggy. Smooth swells from boat wakes. EXCELLENT viewing conditions.
Very warm. Calm. No clouds, but smoky in the basin and fairly clear overhead. No wind. EXCELLENT viewing conditions. Black disc diameter is 60 cm (23.5").
Smooth ripples. Warm, sunny. Light E breeze and smoky skies.
Flat, calm. Warm and sunny. No clouds. EXCELLENT viewing conditions.
Flat, calm. Warm and sunny. No clouds or wind. EXCELLENT viewing conditions.
Hazy sun. Moderate high stratus. Flat, calm. Warm. EXCELLENT viewing conditions.
Waves ~1 ft. with whitecaps. SW wind @5-10 kn. Gusty. Hazy sun and much smog or in-basin haze and increasing lower clouds. FAIR-to-GOOD viewing conditions.
Large, 1.5 ft. easterly swells. Bright sun. Some basin smoke and smog. GOOD viewing conditions.
Ripples. Gusty, light W wind coming up. Full cloud cover.
Ripples from NW. Cool and breezy. GOOD viewing conditions.
Waves ~0.5 ft. Gusty W winds @5-15 kn. Sun partially obscured by high stratus. Some sky reflection. FAIR-to-GOOD viewing conditions.
Some sky reflection. Flat, calm. High cloud cover 95%. Cool. No wind. EXCELLENT viewing conditions.
Waves ~1 ft. with SW gusty winds @10-20 kn. Sky reflection 100%. FAIR-to-GOOD viewing conditions.
Snowing and blowing from NW @10-15 kn. Waves ~1 ft. Sky reflection 100%. No sun visible. FAIR viewing conditions.
Large 2-ft swells from E. Bright sun. No clouds or smog. Cold. GOOD viewing conditions. Lake seems to be clearing up as it mixes deeper.
Strong (20-30 kn), gusty winds. ~90% overcast. Waves 1-2 ft. Some sky reflection. FAIR viewing conditions.
Calm. Hazy sun through high, thickening clouds. Cooling. GOOD viewing conditions.
Smooth SE ripples. Bright sun. No clouds. Light SE breeze @1 kn with small ripple. Moderate smog. Warming and sunny. EXCELLENT viewing conditions.

Flat, calm. Filtered sun through 90% high, thin clouds. No wind. Light smog. EXCELLENT viewing conditions. Cool, calm day preceded by several stormy days with strong SW winds @15-35 kn. Temp. profile (~5.1 to 4.9 C) indicates at least partial mixing.
Ripples from NE. Some sky reflection. Filtered sun through high stratus. GOOD viewing conditions.
Flat, calm. Sunny. No clouds. Warm. EXCELLENT viewing conditions. Water seems clearer than last LTP.
Ripples and 0.5 ft waves. Partly cloudy (~50%). Many sun breaks. GOOD viewing conditions. Breeze SW @10-15 kn.
Smooth ripples with 1-2 kn NE breeze. Cool and sunny. Few clouds. EXCELLENT viewing conditions. Water appears a bit "cloudy".
Sun glare on sunny side. EXCELLENT viewing conditions. Cool. Sunny. Few clouds.
Ripples with gusty SW breezes. Sunny most of the time. GOOD viewing conditions.
Cool. Easterly, light breeze. Ripples. Sunny. No clouds. EXCELLENT viewing conditions.
Flat, calm. Warm and sunny. No wind. EXCELLENT viewing conditions. Lots of phytoplankton in zooplankton sample.
Warm. Calm. Sunny. No clouds or wind. Light smog. EXCELLENT viewing conditions. Lots of algae in zooplankton sample.
Nice. Warm. Sunny. Cloudless. Light smog. EXCELLENT viewing conditions.

Smooth swells from many boat wakes. Warm. Clear. Sunny. Light smog overhead and in basin except for around "Gondola" fire at South Lake Tahoe. GOOD-to-EXCELLENT viewing conditions. Some algae in zooplankton sample.
NE breeze @5 kn. Waves 1.5 ft. Cool and sunny. No clouds. GOOD viewing conditions. Smoke from fires near Topaz Lake SE of Tahoe not entering basin but visible over South Lake Tahoe.
Ripples. NE breeze @2-3 kn shifting to SW during readings. Strong surface reflections. GOOD-to-EXCELLENT viewing conditions.
Smooth swells from boat wakes. No wind or clouds but quite smoky. Warm, bright sun. Strong glint on surface. GOOD-to-EXCELLENT viewing conditions.

Flat, calm. 100% high overcast, but weak sun shining. EXCELLENT viewing conditions. Ripples came up ruining DAF's viewing conditions.
Ripples. 2-3 kn breeze from west. GOOD viewing conditions.
Only FAIR conditions due to 15 kn NE wind. Cold. Waves ~2 ft and whitecaps.
Flat, calm. No wind or clouds. EXCELLENT viewing conditions even with low sun angle.
Ripples from light SW breeze. High, thin cloud cover ~75%. GOOD viewing conditions.
Smooth ripples. Sky with high, moderate overcast ~60%. Light breeze. FAIR-to-GOOD viewing conditions.
Ripples from NW. Light breeze @~1-2 kn. But sky clear. GOOD viewing conditions. Lake seems to be clearing slightly.
Smooth ripples. Heavy smoke overcast. Sun barely visible.
Smooth ripples and light breeze from west. ~10% cumulus clouds around basin. Bright, warm sun. Light haze. GOOD viewing conditions.
Flat and calm with smooth swells. No clouds or wind. EXCELLENT viewing conditions.
Flat, calm. Bright sun. EXCELLENT viewing conditions. Dead zooplankton floating on surface.
Flat, calm. No wind. Weak sun but 100% cloud cover and sky reflection. GOOD-to-EXCELLENT viewing conditions.
Calm. EXCELLENT viewing conditions.
Flat, calm. Some haze and smog over sun. EXCELLENT viewing conditions.
Smooth ripples. Sky clear. Dense fog almost gone. No wind. EXCELLENT viewing conditions.

Waves from west @~1-1.25 ft. FAIR-to-GOOD viewing conditions.
Flat, calm. Some sky reflection due to 60-70% stratus cloud cover. EXCELLENT viewing conditions.
Flat, calm. No clouds or wind but smoggy. EXCELLENT viewing conditions.
Smooth ripples. Warm sun. ~5% cumulus clouds to west. Light breeze. EXCELLENT viewing conditions. It looks as if an algal bloom has started (apparent in the zooplankton tow)!
Smooth, calm. Warm sun. GOOD viewing.
Wind from NE @1-2 kn. Ripples. Bright sun through high clouds. GOOD viewing conditions.
Smooth ripples from west with a light breeze. High cirrostratus clouds over sun, GOOD viewing conditions.

Flat, calm. No wind. Sun bright with no clouds over it. Heavy basin smog from USFS controlled burning (?). EXCELLENT viewing conditions. Many dead zooplankton floating on the calm lake surface in small patches.
Waves ~1 ft from NNW. Cool. ~50% cumulus, but none over sun. GOOD viewing conditions.
Smooth swells. No wind. Bright sun through basin "smaze". EXCELLENT viewing conditions.
Calm. Smooth ripples. No clouds. Bright sun. GOOD viewing conditions.
Flat, calm. Clear, blue sky. No wind. Bright sun. Moderate smog. EXCELLENT viewing conditions. Some algae in zooplankton net.
Smooth ripples. Bright sun. GOOD-to-EXCELLENT viewing conditions. Zooplankton tow is green-brown with phytoplankton.
Smooth ripples. Light breeze. Hazy sun. ~80% high, thin, overcast. GOOD viewing conditions.
Smooth ripples from NW. Sky clear over bright sun. GOOD viewing conditions. Algal bloom is still progressing.
Flat, calm. Bright sun but smoggy. EXCELLENT viewing conditions.

Flat, calm. Light, wispy stratus over sun and ~30% around basin. Warm. No wind. EXCELLENT viewing conditions. Water seems less clear here at mid-lake than at index yesterday due to strong, westshore upwelling (strong winds and snow showers on 4/18/87).
Flat, calm. No clouds. Some high haze. Warm and sunny. No wind. EXCELLENT viewing conditions.
Surface rippled. Wind coming up from NE @2-4 kn in gusts. Sky clear, under bright sun. GOOD viewing conditions. Some pollen visible in surface waters.
Flat, calm. Bright sun. No clouds (basin is smoggy). Pollen on surface but not over disc. Many Diaptomus (some females with eggs) visible. EXCELLENT viewing conditions.
Smooth ripples. Clear sky over sun. Light breeze. Warm. GOOD-to-EXCELLENT viewing conditions.
Calm. No wind. Bright, warm sun. EXCELLENT viewing conditions.
Flat, calm. No wind. Warm and very smoky with clouds (thin) over sun. Otherwise EXCELLENT viewing conditions.

Flat, calm. High, moderate haze ~80%. Warm, hazy sun. EXCELLENT viewing conditions.
Some sky reflection. Smooth ripples and 2 ft swells. 100% high, cloud cover and weak sun but no wind = GOOD viewing conditions. There seems to be some net-clogging algae in the zooplankton sample.
Flat, calm. Bright sun. No wind. EXCELLENT viewing conditions.

Flat, calm. A bit of sky reflection but no wind. Strong sun. EXCELLENT viewing conditions.
Ripples. Light SE breeze. Sky overcast, ~75% cumulus. Sun behind clouds. GOOD viewing conditions. Secchi much deeper than on last MLTP!
Flat, calm, no wind. Sun bright. No clouds. Cool (29 degrees F). Smoggy - but EXCELLENT viewing conditions. With the strong winds over the last 5-6 days, the lake should have mixed!

Calm with light ripple. Sun slightly covered with thin clouds. Cool, light breeze. EXCELLENT viewing conditions. A calm day following a week of moderate to strong SW winds and storms. Lake should have mixed from this! Lake level has risen ~3-4".
Waves ~1.5-2 ft from SW 15 kn wind which sprang up ~20 min. ago. Sun bright. Sky clear. But only FAIR-to-GOOD conditions due to waves. Water not as clear as 3 weeks ago.

Clear sky (except for forest fire smoke coming into basin from SW). Calm. Warm, bright sun. EXCELLENT viewing conditions.
Ripples. 1-2 kn breeze from E. Bright sun. No clouds but moderate smog. GOOD-to-EXCELLENT viewing conditions.
Flat, calm. No clouds or wind, but smoggy. EXCELLENT viewing conditions.

Almost calm with small ripples. Bright sun. No clouds. Light breeze but quite smoggy! GOOD-to-EXCELLENT viewing conditions. A whole bunch more Uroglena americana colonies quite visible as "dust" between sunlit Secchi disk and surface!
Smooth ripples. Light breeze. Bright sun. No clouds. EXCELLENT viewing conditions, but Uroglena americana bloom continues to hamper good readings!
Flat, calm, no wind. Moderate, hazy sun due to ~80% high cumulus cloud cover. EXCELLENT viewing conditions. Uroglena americana still reigns!

Flat, calm, no wind. But 100% high stratus covers a weak sun. Otherwise GOOD-to-EXCELLENT viewing conditions. Very heavy snowstorm (3.5-4 ft) and strong SW winds @10-40 kn during the past 3-4 days. Water is definitely clearer.
Flat, calm, no wind. High, moderate, stratus overcast. Cool. Sun shining through clouds. EXCELLENT viewing conditions.
Smooth ripples from the east with 1 kn breeze. Sun bright. GOOD viewing conditions.
Flat, calm, no wind. Bright sun. Some smog. EXCELLENT viewing conditions.

Rippled with wind from NE @2-3 kn. Bright sun.
Flat, calm. No clouds or wind. Water a bit cloudy. EXCELLENT viewing conditions.
Flat, calm. Bright, warm sun. No clouds over sun. EXCELLENT viewing conditions.
NE breeze @1-2 kn. Waves 0.5 ft. Sky clear. Sun bright. GOOD viewing conditions.
Flat, calm. Bright sun. No wind. Hazy. EXCELLENT viewing conditions.

Smooth ripples. GOOD viewing conditions. But sun not visible through 100% cloud cover.

Flat, calm. Bright sun. No cloud cover. EXCELLENT viewing conditions.

Flat, calm. Sun behind moderate high stratus. No wind. GOOD-to-EXCELLENT viewing conditions.
Flat, calm. Warm sun. High thin-to-moderate haze. EXCELLENT viewing conditions. Uroglenopsis still very abundant! The strong winds of the last 1.5 days should have mixed the lake a bit deeper.

Flat, calm. Some cloud and sky reflection. No wind. Hazy sun. But EXCELLENT viewing conditions. (* Sun clouded over during DAH's reading.)

Flat, calm. Bright sun. No wind. EXCELLENT viewing conditions.
Flat, calm. Bright, warm sun but quite smoggy. No wind. EXCELLENT viewing conditions.
Flat, calm. Warm, bright sun. Moderate-to-heavy in-basin smog. EXCELLENT viewing conditions. Lots of zooplankton visible above Secchi disk in the white reflection.
Flat, calm. Bright, warm sun. Light haze. EXCELLENT viewing conditions. Smoky in basin from 6000+ acre Belli Ranch fire SW of Reno.
Calm. Warm. Sunny. No clouds. Moderate in-basin smog. EXCELLENT viewing conditions.
Flat, calm. Warm sun. No clouds but smoky from controlled burns in progress at Sugar Pine Pt. State Park. EXCELLENT viewing conditions.
Flat, calm. Bright sun with no clouds over it. Very smoky in basin from many USFS controlled burns. EXCELLENT viewing conditions.
No wind. Calm. Sky 100% covered with high stratus. Weak sun. GOOD-to-EXCELLENT viewing conditions during RCR's reading.
Smooth ripples from east. Cool. No clouds over sun. Sun angle fairly low and to the west. GOOD-to-EXCELLENT viewing conditions.
Waves and whitecaps from SW. 1-2 ft. swells. Bright sun. Wind increasing to 15 kn. FAIR-to-GOOD viewing conditions.
Waves ~1-1.5 ft. from NW with breeze @~5 kn and ripples. Bright sun. No clouds. Light smog. GOOD viewing conditions.
Warm, bright sun. No clouds. Light west breeze and ripples. GOOD-to-EXCELLENT viewing conditions.
Flat, calm. No wind or ripples. Bright, warm sun. Water looks "cloudy". EXCELLENT viewing conditions. Black matte-finish 60 cm diameter Secchi disk used for the first time on an MLTP.
Light, warm westerly breeze and ripples. Clear sky. EXCELLENT viewing conditions.
Flat, calm. Bright, warm sun. No wind or clouds. Smoggy. EXCELLENT viewing conditions.

EXCELLENT viewing conditions. Warm. Sunny; sun bright between clouds. A few ripples. Lots of dead zooplankton on surface. Black disk actually "disappears" more quickly when sun coming under the boat strikes it when it's being lowered on the shady side!
Smooth 1-ft swells. Sun in and out behind gathering clouds. Light SW breezes. GOOD viewing conditions.
Flat, calm. 85% high stratus. Sun behind clouds. Warm. EXCELLENT viewing conditions. Wood and prescribed burn smoke.
Smooth swells ~1 ft. but no sun visible. Light breezes. Snowing lightly. FAIR viewing conditions.
Rough with ~2-ft. waves. Snowing with ~10 kn wind. Visibility ~300 yd. No sun. FAIR viewing conditions.
Lots of sky reflection. Snowing lightly. Wind SW @10 kn with 1-2 ft. waves. FAIR viewing conditions ("terrible" according to DAH).
Flat, calm. Bright sun, but cool. No clouds. EXCELLENT viewing conditions.
Flat, calm. Cool and sunny. No wind or clouds. EXCELLENT viewing conditions.
West wind @2-3 kn with 0.5 ft. waves. Sun intermittent. Cool. Some cloud sky reflection. GOOD viewing conditions.
GOOD viewing conditions. Sunny. No clouds. SW breeze. Clouds gathering for afternoon thunderstorms.

Rough! Waves ~2-2.5 ft with SW wind @15 kn and whitecaps. FAIR-to-GOOD viewing conditions. Decided to abort black Secchi readings due to large swells which would have collapsed it!
EXCELLENT viewing conditions. Water is a greenish-blue. No clouds. Bright sun. Ripples. Smoky (moderate) from in-basin prescribed burns.

Flat, calm. Bright sun. Warming. EXCELLENT viewing conditions. There are a lot of "particles" in the shallow water light reflection between the white Secchi and the observer. Most likely, it is another bloom of Uroglenopsis?
Flat, calm. Cloud cover breaking up. Cool. GOOD-to-EXCELLENT viewing conditions. There are still "particles" reflected over the white Secchi disk in shallow water.
EXCELLENT viewing conditions. Smooth ripples. Light easterly breeze. Sunny. Cool. No clouds.
Smooth swells. Sunny and cool. Wind has stopped. EXCELLENT viewing conditions. Lake may still be mixing given the good transparency values and low water temperatures. This is unusual!
West wind @5-10 kn. Whitecaps 1.5 ft. Sunny and cool. FAIR-to-GOOD viewing conditions.
NW wind @10-15 kn. A cold, light rain. No sun. Waves 1.5 ft. Only FAIR viewing conditions. Much sky reflection. Too rough to take "black" Secchi depth reading.
SW winds @5-10 kn. Clear and sunny. Waves ~1.5 ft. FAIR-to-GOOD viewing conditions.
Smooth swells. Warm, bright sun. No clouds. EXCELLENT viewing conditions. Patty Bucknell's first Secchi readings.

GOOD viewing conditions initially but deteriorating rapidly as cumulus clouds move in and SW breeze picks up. FAIR viewing conditions for black Secchi reading. Clouds moving in. Ripples. Moderate-to-heavy in-basin smoke and haze.
Smooth swells. Sunny, warm. No wind or clouds. Little smog. EXCELLENT viewing conditions.

Starting to get rough. South wind increasing to 15 kn under cloudy skies (95%) with snow showers approaching. GOOD viewing conditions.
EXCELLENT viewing conditions. Sun now shining. Calm. Light breezes and small swells.
Only FAIR viewing conditions due to 2.5 ft. waves. Total cloud cover. Wind SW @ 10-15 kn and approaching snow.

EXCELLENT viewing conditions. Moderately strong sun through 100% high stratus. Calm.
Flat, calm. Warm, sunny. Cloudless. Light smog. EXCELLENT viewing conditions. Water is blue but "cloudy" (due to rotifers??).
Water seems quite clear. Warm, sunny. Flat, calm. EXCELLENT viewing conditions. Some pollen on the surface. Black Secchi readings may be the deepest we've gotten? (almost-PAA)
Flat, calm. "Hot" and sunny. No clouds. EXCELLENT viewing conditions. Lake is clearing up early this year due to low precipitation levels and runoff.
